sources.notes: UNTESTED: access to the file was refused (403 gated) for the lead's token, so the row layout was never seen. The trajectories are the file openswe_traj.jsonl (4,868,162,699 bytes, about 13,000 curated trajectories from about 9,000 environments per the card; SWE-Agent and OpenHands scaffolds, teacher models not named on the card). This file is NOT listed under the card's configs (the card only defines openswe_oss and openswe_other, which are environment definitions: problem statement, patch, test patch, Dockerfile, evaluation script; no agent turns, so excluded). After access is granted: sample openswe_traj.jsonl, then fix adapter (open_swe, openhands_xml or swe_agent_fenced), field_map (family from instance_id) and outcome mapping. filtered_ids.csv (237 KB) lists the environments kept by the difficulty filter.
